en: Though I am unknown, I do not feel emptyFor I am satisfied in Jesus alone
Though I am poor, I lack nothing For I am truly rich in Jesus alone
I can endure in the midst of trials Because I trust in Your sovereign plan
Though I may fail, I can rise again For I have the victory in Jesus alone
I am filled with Jesus, Jesus, JesusI am filled with Jesus, Jesus, Jesus
I am filled with Jesus, Jesus, Jesus The Eternal King lives inside of me

ko: 내 몸이 약해도 낙심하지 않는 것은
en: Though my body is weak, I do not lose heart For I am made perfect in Jesus alone
I do not envy this glamorous world For I am filled with Jesus, Jesus
I am filled with Jesus, Jesus, Jesus The world has nothing that I desire
I am filled with Jesus, Jesus, Jesus The Eternal King lives inside of me
I am filled with Jesus, Jesus, Jesus I fear no storms of this world
I am filled with Jesus, Jesus, Jesus The Eternal King lives inside of me
